description: Which models did this make produce in a given model year? Lists the model names NHTSA holds for a make and year, A to Z, so an agent can check the exact model name before a recall, complaint or crash-rating lookup. For dealers, form-filling and data cleaning. Source: NHTSA vPIC. It includes every vehicle type the make registered (cars, motorcycles, trucks) with US model names, and does not give trims or specifications. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, max models to return, 1-100, default 25

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda

name: vehicle_models_for_make_year
